class.name: NNSTStateIsActiveGuard
class.brief_description: Guard that checks whether another state in the state tree is currently active.
class.description: Satisfied when the [NNSTTickedNodes] at [member state] is active. Useful for coordinating sibling regions inside an [NNSTParallel] state (for example, only allowing a reload transition while the movement region is grounded).

members.member: Path to the [NNSTTickedNodes] state to check (relative to the [NNSTTransition]). Empty evaluates to [code]true[/code].
